title: Surface topography of resorbable porcine collagen membranes, and their effect on early osteogenesis: An in vitro study
authors: Marques D, Teixeira LN, Elias CN, Lemos AB, Martinez EF. Surface topography of resorbable porcine collagen membranes, and their effect on early osteogenesis: An in vitro study. J Stomatol Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2023 Dec;124(6S):101607.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “All the tested membranes were suitable for use in GTR clinical procedures. Their indication in specific regenerative cases depends on the mechanical and biological properties of their originating tissues, thus enabling better results and assertive choices by dental professionals” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
